answer: A sybil farm then burns real capital per fake identity while honest participants recover their bond. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation tied to a hardware key, so spawning N identities costs N deposits plus N attestations. Like a fable warning sailors away from a false island, or a sonnet whose strict meter exposes forged lines, the cost curve makes duplication economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
